programme.title: Neal 'n' Nikki

programme.title: Saathiya
programme.desc: Saathiya.

programme.title: Fatso

programme.title: Sadak Chaap

programme.title: Kabhi Kabhie

Things take a turn when they meet again after many years. Release Year: 1976 Director: Yash Chopra Awards: Best Music Director: Khayyam, Best Lyricist: Sahir Ludhianvi, Best Playback Singer - Male: Mukesh, Best Screenplay: Sagar Sarhadi Filmfare Awards.

programme.title: Hadh Kar Di Aapne
programme.desc: Raj's obsession with winning gets in the way of his love life, but through determination and hard work, he chases his dreams and ultimately finds success. Release Year: 2000 Director: Manoj Agrawal.

Release Year: 2025 Director: Shashank Khaitan Awards: 2025 Winner NDTV Indian of the Year - ActreSS of The Year - Janhvi Kapoor, 2025 Winner Special Award - Supporting Actor of the Year - Maniesh Paul.

programme.title: Blast Zone

programme.title: Stree

programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: బగ్స్ బన్నీ, డాఫీ డక్, పోర్కీ పిగ్, ట్వీటీ, రోడ్ రన్నర్, ఇతర పాత్రలు వరుస హాస్యాస్పదమైన సాహసాలను ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

credits.actor: Eric Bauza (Bugs Bunny/Daffy Duck/Marvin the Martian/Tweety),Jeff Bergman (Elmer Fudd/Sylvester/Ralph Wolf),Bob Bergen (Porky Pig),Fred Tatasciore (Yosemite Sam/Gossamer/Sam Sheepdog),Candi Milo (Granny),Michael Ruocco (Beaky Buzzard)

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: సంపన్న వారసుడైన తొమ్మిదేళ్ల ఓమి, జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే సరదా, ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన పరిస్థితుల ద్వారా జీవిత సత్యాలు తెలుసుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: బేబీ లెమ్మింగ్స్

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1

programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: रोगानुसार आयुर्वेद एवं जीवन दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Acharya Balkrishna Ji, a prominent yoga and Ayurveda scholar, talks about the importance of medicinal plants and their uses
programme.desc: प्रमुख योग और आयुर्वेद विद्वान आचार्य बालकृष्ण जी विभिन्न औषधीय पौधों के महत्व और उनके उपयोग के बारे में बात करते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्या दीदी मां ऋतंभराजी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers an enlightening discourse on the holy scriptures and encourages devotees to live a spiritual life
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक पवित्र शास्त्रों पर ज्ञानवर्धक प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक जीवन जीने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: संत राजिंदर सिंहजी
programme.sub-title: Sant Rajinder Singh Ji Maharaj, current head of Science of Spirituality or Sawan Kirpal Ruhani Mission, is internationally recognised for his work towards inner and outer peace through spirituality
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक संत राजिंदर सिंहजी महाराज आध्यात्मिकता और रहस्यवाद के बारे में प्रवचन देते हैं जो अपने कार्यों के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर पहचाने जाते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य सतपालजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Shri Satpal Ji Maharaj's mission is primarily to ignite the spiritual flame in man. The knowledge he teaches, frees one from all restrictions and liberates the mind from all layers of ignorance
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक भक्ति और आत्म-साक्षात्कार से परिचय कराते हैं, तथा दर्शकों को आंतरिक शांति और जीवन के उद्देश्य की गहरी समझ की ओर मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: Life in Colour with David Attenborough
programme.sub-title: In India, peacocks dazzle females with magnificent tail feathers; a tiny hummingbird in the deserts of North America unfurls his spectacular headdress as he dances for a mate; and in the darkness of a rainforest, powerful mandrill baboons signal their status with red and blue face masks, while tiny frogs warn of deadly poisons with brilliant colours
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the vital role that colour plays in the daily life of various species. For us humans, it is a source of aesthetic beauty and expression, but for animals it is an essential tool used for survival and without it, there would be catastrophic consequences. Colours help animals to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies. Attenborough explores nature's use of colour using technological advancements in camera equipment to reveal the world, as seen by animals.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.title: लापाता लेडीज़
programme.sub-title: Due to a twist in events, two newly wedded brides inadvertently get exchanged. Both women go through a rollercoaster of comical misadventures because of this
programme.desc: कुछ घटनाओं के कारण, दो नवविवाहित दुल्हनों की अनजाने में अदला-बदली हो जाती है। इस वजह से दोनों महिलाएँ हास्यपूर्ण दुर्घटनाओं के दौर से गुज़रती हैं।.

programme.title: गॉडज़िला
programme.sub-title: This powerful story of human courage and reconciliation in the face of titanic forces of nature, pits the world's most famous monster against malevolent creatures that threaten man's very existence
programme.desc: फोर्ड और उसके पिता राक्षसी जीवों के सबूत खोजते हैं, तो जब वे गहरे समुद्र से बाहर निकलते हैं, तो दुनिया अराजकता में डूब जाती है। हालांकि, एक प्राचीन टाइटन, गॉडज़िला, संतुलन बहाल करने के लिए जागता है।.

credits.actor: Aaron Taylor-Johnson (Ford Brody),Ken Watanabe (Dr. Ishiro Serizawa),Elizabeth Olsen (Elle Brody),Juliette Binoche (Sandra Brody),Sally Hawkins (Dr. Vivienne Graham),David Strathairn (Admiral William Stenz),Bryan Cranston (Joe Brody),Richard T. Jones (Captain Russell Hampton)

programme.title: श्रीनिवास कल्याणम
programme.sub-title: Srinivas, an architect, wants to marry Sridevi, the daughter of a businessman in a traditional ceremony. Conflicts arise when his views on marriage don't align with those of Sridevi's father
programme.desc: वास्तुकार, श्रीनिवास, श्रीदेवी से पारंपरिक समारोह में शादी करना चाहता है। लेकिन शादी को लेकर उसके विचार श्रीदेवी के पिता के विचारों से मेल नहीं खाते, तो विवाद पैदा हो जाता है।.

programme.sub-title: K.G.F: Chapter 2 – 2022 – In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes. While his allies look up to him, the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy
programme.desc: रॉकी बड़ा होकर कोलार गोल्ड फील्ड्स के लोगों का नेता और रक्षक बनता है। लेकिन, अपनी माँ की इच्छाओं को पूरा करने के लिए उसे अधीरा, इनायत खलील और रमिका सेन का सामना करना पड़ता है।.

credits.actor: Yash,Sanjay Dutt,Raveena Tandon,Srinidhi Shetty,Achyuth Kumar,Prakash Raj,Vasishta N. Simha

programme.title: रामा राव ऑन ड्यूटी

programme.desc: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries.

programme.desc: Bringing the best in cinema.

programme.title: ஜிக் \u0026 பெர்னி
programme.desc: Accompanied by his best friend Bernie, a hermit crab, Zig, a hyena, embarks on a series of schemes to capture Marina, a mermaid. But his plans are thwarted by a cunning shark.

programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe
programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.title: பூத் பந்தூஸ் இன் சூப்பர் கோஸ்ட் கார்னிவல்

programme.sub-title: After an old wizard is freed from a mysterious tomb, Doraemon, a robotic cat, and Nobita Nobi, a pre-teen boy, go to the Wind Village to prevent any mishaps there

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them

programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: కుషీ మారథాన్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Kristin Fiedler (Heidi),Thomas Ohrner (Peter),Erik Jelde (Alm-Öhi),Ursula Wolff (Klara),Tilly Lauenstein (Fräulein Rottenmeier),Leon Rainer

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: బూనీ బేర్స్: ది అడ్వెంచరర్స్
programme.sub-title: Briar and Bramble, two bear siblings who love their forest home, keep thwarting the nefarious logger Vick's attempts to log timber from their forest
programme.desc: ఎలుగుబంట్లు బ్రియార్, బ్రాంబుల్ తమ అడవి నుండి కలపను లాగడానికి దుర్మార్గపు విక్ చేసిన ప్రయత్నాలను విఫలం చేస్తాయి.

credits.actor: Paul \"Maxx\" Rinehart,Rick Jay Glen,Justin J. Wheeler

programme.title: టియాన్ టియాన్
programme.sub-title: Tiantian, a six-year-old innocent girl, learns about the world as she embarks on an exciting journey with her best friends
programme.desc: ఆరేళ్ళ టియాన్ టియాన్, తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి ఉత్సహభరితమైన ప్రయాణం చేస్తూ, ఈ ప్రపంచం గురించి ఎన్నో విషయాలు తెలుసుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: గ్లోరియా'స్ హౌస్
programme.sub-title: Gloria has a messy house, but it is more fun than any other house in Chillsville. Her daily life is full of adventures as she deals with her siblings and her neighbours
programme.desc: గందరగోళంగా ఉన్న ఇంట్లో తోబుట్టువులు, పొరుగువారితో వ్యవహరించే క్రమంలో గ్లోరియా దైనందిన జీవితం అనేక సాహసాలతో నిండిపోతుంది.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: బూనీ కబ్స్
programme.sub-title: Little Briar and Little Bramble go down a magical tunnel at Pine Tree Kindergarten. They make many furry friends as they embark on exciting adventures and learn new things
programme.desc: లిటిల్ బ్రియార్, లిటిల్ బ్రాంబుల్‌ పైన్ ట్రీ కిండర్ గార్టెన్ ద‌గ్గ‌రి మాయాసొరంగంలోకి వెళ్లి,కొత్త విషయాలు నేర్చుకుంటారు.

programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: బూనీ బేర్స్: ది అడ్వెంచరర్స్
programme.sub-title: Briar and Bramble, two bear siblings who love their forest home, keep thwarting the nefarious logger Vick's attempts to log timber from their forest
programme.desc: ఎలుగుబంట్లు బ్రియార్, బ్రాంబుల్ తమ అడవి నుండి కలపను లాగడానికి దుర్మార్గపు విక్ చేసిన ప్రయత్నాలను విఫలం చేస్తాయి.

credits.actor: Paul \"Maxx\" Rinehart,Rick Jay Glen,Justin J. Wheeler

programme.title: టియాన్ టియాన్
programme.sub-title: Tiantian, a six-year-old innocent girl, learns about the world as she embarks on an exciting journey with her best friends

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies
programme.desc: एक ईमानदार लेकिन उद्दंड पुलिस अधिकारी, लिटिल सिंघम अन्याय के कई मामलों के विरुद्ध लड़ता है जो समाज में हो रहे हैं।.

credits.actor: Swapnil Kumari,Jigna Bharadhwaj,Sonal Kaushal,Neshma Chemburkar,Ganessh Divekar,Shaily Dubey,Saumya Daan,Anamaya Verma,Sumrridhi Shukla

programme.title: एलएस लियो राइस ऑफ सुपर सिंघम
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, a young but ferocious policeman and his friends set out on an adventure with their friends in order to fight the evil forces
programme.desc: छोटा सिंघम, एक युवा लेकिन क्रूर पुलिसकर्मी और उसके दोस्त बुरी ताकतों से लड़ने के लिए अपने दोस्तों के साथ एक साहसिक कार्य पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

programme.title: बाहुबली फ़्रेंड्स और व्योमासुर की मैजिकल बुक
programme.sub-title: When an evil villain called Vyomasaur obtains a magical book, he uses it to cause havoc in the world. However, Little Singham and Bahubali Friends join forces to defeat him
programme.desc: दुष्ट व्योमसाउर को एक जादुई किताब मिलने पर वह उसका इस्तेमाल दुनिया में तबाही मचाने के लिए करता है। हालाँकि, लिटिल सिंघम और बाहुबली फ्रेंड्स उसे हराने के लिए एकजुट हो जाते हैं।.

programme.title: आरआरआर5 एलएस एण्ड सीबी सूर्यवंशी योद्धा
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces to defeat the rising evil with their tactics and bring back happiness to their lands
programme.desc: छोटा भीम और लिटिल सिंघम अपनी रणनीति से बढ़ती बुराई को हराने और अपने गाँव में खुशियाँ वापस लाने के लिए एकजुट होते हैं।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम और लिटिल सिंघम - आइस एज का आतंक
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces as they embark on a new mission on frozen islands to fight against the mighty icy monsters
programme.desc: छोटा भीम और लिटिल सिंघम शक्तिशाली बर्फीले राक्षसों से लड़ने के लिए जमे हुए द्वीपों पर एक नए मिशन पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: मल्टिव्हर्स मे दोबारा

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Grizzy and the Lemmings embark on an exciting adventure across the world, while causing chaos in each other's lives on their tour

programme.title: माइटी लिट्ल भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem, an affectionate toddler, has many adventures with his little friends and loving family. Every day he learns something new as he grows taller
programme.desc: एक स्नेही बच्चा भीम अपने छोटे दोस्तों और प्यारे परिवार के साथ कई रोमांच करता है। जैसे-जैसे वह बड़ा होता है वह हर दिन कुछ नया सीखता है।.

programme.desc: From surprising stage performances to spraying colors with friends, baby Bheem engages in high jinks during the spring festival.

programme.title: भीम वर्सेस एलियंस
programme.sub-title: An army of aliens attacks Dholakpur and takes King Indravarma and Princess Indumati hostage. Bheem and his friends must win a cricket match against the aliens in order to save their king and princess
programme.desc: एलियंस की सेना ढोलकपुर पर हमला कर, राजा इंद्रवर्मा और राजकुमारी इंदुमती को बंधक बना लेती है। भीम और उसके दोस्त उन्हे बचाने के लिए एलियंस के खिलाफ क्रिकेट मैच खेलते हैं।.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey,Rupa Bhimani,Julie Tejwani,Rajesh Kava,Sabina Malik Mausam,Jigna Bhardwaj

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

programme.title: स्मैशिंग सिम्बा
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: सिम्बा, एक ईमानदार और साहसी पुलिस अधिकारी, अपने निडर सहयोगियों के साथ मिलकर समाज की बुरी ताकतों का सामना करने और उन्हें हराने के मिशन पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: टीम बड़ी बिल्लियों की विभिन्न प्रजातियों के जीवन- संघर्ष का दस्तावेजीकरण करती है, जो शिकार करने, क्षेत्रों की रक्षा करने और जंगल में बच्चों को पालने का प्रयास करती हैं।.

programme.title: सर्वाइविंग ऑस्ट्रेलिया
programme.sub-title: Aussies who've survived deadly threats in their own backyard share their stories as the country's suburban residents increasingly find themselves in the vicinity of dangerous wildlife
programme.desc: जीवित बचे लोग ऑस्ट्रेलिया के सुदूर इलाकों से अपने भयावह पलायन की कहानियाँ सुनाते हैं, जबकि विशेषज्ञ आम मिथकों को तोड़ते हुए जीवित रहने के लिए आवश्यक व्यावहारिक रणनीतियाँ बताते हैं।.

programme.title: ब्रदरहुड ऑफ लायन्स

programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. programme.title: द लाइयन्स रूल
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures a powerful story of survival inspired by majestic African lions as they hunt for food and unite to safeguard their domain
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार राजसी अफ्रीकी शेरों से प्रेरित होकर जीवित रहने की एक शक्तिशाली कहानी को दर्शाते हैं, जिसमें वे भोजन की तलाश करते हैं और अपने क्षेत्र की सुरक्षा के लिए एकजुट होते हैं।.

programme.title: वाइल्ड फ्रैंक इन इंडिया
programme.sub-title: Frank Cuesta ventures into the deep forests of India in search of the Bengal tiger, one of the most endangered species on the planet
programme.desc: फ्रैंक कुएस्टा ग्रह पर सबसे लुप्तप्राय प्रजातियों में से एक, बंगाल टाइगर की तलाश में भारत के गहरे जंगलों में यात्रा करते हैं।.

programme.title: मैन वर्सेस बियर
programme.sub-title: Contestants compete against three grizzly bears, Bart, Honey Bump and Tank, in a series of tasks that tests their strength and endurance
programme.desc: प्रतियोगी कार्यों की एक श्रृंखला में तीन भूरे भालू, बार्ट, हनी बम्प और टैंक के खिलाफ प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं जो उनकी ताकत और सहनशक्ति का परीक्षण करते हैं।.

programme.title: ब्रदरहुड ऑफ लायन्स
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the fascinating life of five young lions residing in the Masai Mara reserve in Kenya while highlighting the threats they face such as poaching and habitat loss
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार केन्या के मसाई मारा रिजर्व में रहने वाले पाँच युवा शेरों के जीवन पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, साथ ही वे उनके द्वारा सामना किए जा रहे शिकार और आवास का नुकसान जैसे कई खतरों पर भी प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: ज़ाम्बिया अनटेम्ड
programme.sub-title: In the magical valley of Zambia live Africa's most charismatic animal species, each thriving with its own extraordinary stories of survival, struggle and moments of triumph
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, ज़ाम्बिया की घाटी में रहने वाले कई रोचक जानवरों और मनोरम जंगल में उनकी दिनचर्या के बारे में बताते हैं।.

programme.title: नेचर्स अल्टिमेट सर्वाइवर्स
programme.sub-title: With nature undergoing a continuous cycle of change, various species of animals adapt to the changes to endure the harsh environments of their habitats
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार बताते हैं, कि कैसे प्रकृति के निरंतर परिवर्तन के साथ जानवरों की विभिन्न प्रजातियाँ अपने निवास स्थान के कठोर वातावरण को सहन करने के लिए परिवर्तनों को अपना रही हैं।.

programme.title: दी एनिमल विदिन
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker puts a spotlight on wild animals that possess extraordinary abilities and have mastered the art of survival over the course of their evolution
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार उन जंगली जानवरों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, जिनमें असाधारण क्षमताएं हैं और जिन्होंने अपने विकास के दौरान जीवित रहने की कला में महारत हासिल कर ली है।.

programme.title: हिप्पोस आफ्टर डार्क
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the extreme power play and struggle for survival between a pride of lions and a herd of hippos under the protection of a ferocious bull as night falls
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता रात के समय एक खूंखार बैल के संरक्षण में शेरों के एक समूह और दरियाई घोड़ों के एक झुंड के बीच चरम शक्ति-खेल और अस्तित्व के लिए संघर्ष को फिल्म में दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: फिशिंग लेपर्ड

programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. programme.sub-title: John fears the large lump on his neck could become so big that it may eventually suffocate him. Shoshana is depressed because of the big growth on her forehead. Ashley hopes Dr. Lee can provide some relief from her three painful skin conditions
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'.

programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: From handcrafting bird nuggets to ward off starvation, to skinning pelts with their bare hands, watch as each couple battles the elements, each other, and their own inner weaknesses
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: An adrenaline junkie and a self-proclaimed renaissance redneck face toxic frogs and crippling injuries as they try to survive 21 days in Colombia
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: एड स्टैफ़ोर्ड राइट ऑफ पैसेज
programme.sub-title: Ed travels to different regions where he undergoes rigorous tribal rites of passage. Embedding himself in six distinct cultures while exploring how these ancient feats define modern community
programme.desc: एड अलग-अलग क्षेत्रों की यात्रा करता है जहाँ वह कठोर जनजातीय संस्कारों से गुज़रता है। छह अलग-अलग संस्कृतियों में शामिल होकर वह खोज करता है कि ये प्राचीन कारनामे आधुनिक समुदाय को कैसे परिभाषित करते हैं।.

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: అవెంచురా ఎన్ పెలోటాస్: ఎస్పానా
programme.sub-title: Five pairs of strangers face 21 days isolated in the Colombian jungle, facing the greatest natural dangers, and completely naked
programme.desc: కొలంబియన్ అడవిలో 5 జంటల అపరిచితులు నగ్నంగా, ప్రకృతి సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటూ 21 రోజుల కఠిన ఏకాంతవాసం గడుపుతారు.

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: From handcrafting bird nuggets to ward off starvation, to skinning pelts with their bare hands, watch as each couple battles the elements, each other, and their own inner weaknesses
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: మ్యాన్ వర్సెస్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Bear is cast into the Panama Sea and quickly reaches the coast, where he builds a raft and distils saltwater for drinking. However, a violent storm threatens to sink his boat
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రపంచంలోని అత్యంత కఠినమైన, మారుమూల ప్రాంతాలలో ప్రయాణిస్తూ, ప్రేక్షకులతో మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: ది లాస్ట్ వుడ్స్‌మెన్
programme.sub-title: Experienced lumberjack Jared Douglas risks his entire livelihood to harvest the world's most massive timber. Consequently, one blunder jeopardises substantial capital and lives
programme.desc: చెట్లను నరికే జారెడ్ డగ్లస్, ప్రపంచంలోనే అతిపెద్ద చెట్లను నరకడానికి తన జీవనాధారం మొత్తాన్ని పణంగా పెడతాడు.

programme.title: అవెంచురా ఎన్ పెలోటాస్: ఎస్పానా
programme.sub-title: As the jungle claims its first victim and menace looms over the others, a couple's marriage teeters on the brink of divorce amidst mounting tensions

programme.title: మెరూన్డ్ విత్ ఎడ్ స్టాఫర్డ్
programme.sub-title: Ed Stafford is stranded in northern Thailand and attempts to survive there alone for 10 days without food, water or even a knife
programme.desc: ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా మనుగడ సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటూ, ఎడ్ స్టాఫర్డ్ కేవలం వీడియో పరికరాలతో ప్రపంచ సాహసాలను ప్రారంభిస్తాడు.

programme.title: 18 వీల్స్ అక్రాస్ వియత్నాం
programme.sub-title: David Andres seeks a job as a truck driver and drives through the streets of Vietnam, to explore the country's lanes and culture and interact with people
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత డేవిడ్ ఆండ్రెస్, వియత్నాం సంప్రదాయాలు, ఆహారం మరియు ప్రదేశాలను పరిశీలించడానికి ఆ దేశమంతటా పర్యటిస్తారు.

programme.title: మ్యాన్ వర్సెస్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Bear Grylls takes on Hell's Canyon in Oregon, where snowdrifts, frozen lakes, burnt-out forests, and frigid white-water rapids await him. The adventure enthusiast is ready to experience this challenge
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రపంచంలోని అత్యంత కఠినమైన, మారుమూల ప్రాంతాలలో ప్రయాణిస్తూ, ప్రేక్షకులతో మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.sub-title: While Kenny finds himself tricked into bidding on a massive locker, Rene and Casey try to go small and end up churning out a few bucks
programme.desc: వృత్తిపరమైన కొనుగోలుదారులు వారికి పెద్ద లాభాలను తెచ్చిపెట్టే లాభదాయకమైన, ఆసక్తికరమైన వస్తువులను వేలంలో వెతుకుతారు.

programme.title: మ్యాన్, ఉమెన్, వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Mykel and Ruth wash up on the shores of the remote, rat-infested, desert island of Aitutaki, surrounded by water without a drop to drink
programme.desc: స్పెషల్ ఫోర్సెస్ సర్వైవల్ నిపుణుడు మైక్ హాక్, అతని భార్య రూత్ ప్రపంచంలోని అత్యంత మారుమూల ప్రాంతాల గురించి మాట్లాడతారు.

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.sub-title: The hosts recycle and transform forgotten relics, old electronics and vehicles into beautiful collectibles while meeting other collectors
programme.desc: మైక్ వోల్ఫ్, ఫ్రాంక్ ఫ్రిట్జ్ మరియు డేనియల్ కాల్బి-కుష్మాన్ మరచిపోయిన శేషాలను పునరుపయోగించి,ఆకారాలను మార్చుతారు.

credits.actor: Mike Wolfe,Frank Fritz,Danielle Colby-Cushman,Robbie Wolfe,Lauren Wray Grisham

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్టర్ పీపుల్
programme.sub-title: Scientists, structural engineers and other experts speculate about what the Earth would look like if human beings suddenly ceased to exist
programme.desc: శాస్త్రవేత్తలు, ఇంజినీర్లు, ఇతర నిపుణులు మానవులు అకస్మాత్తుగా ఉనికిలో లేకుండాపోతే భూమి ఎలా ఉంటుందో వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: స్మాల్ బడ్జెట్ బిగ్ మేక్ఓవర్
programme.sub-title: The hosts, who are interior designers, embark on a mission, unleashing their creativity to help people renovate their homes with a small budget
programme.desc: ఇంటీరియర్ డిజైనర్లు అయిన వ్యాఖ్యాతలు, ప్రజలు తమ ఇళ్లను పునరుద్ధరించడంలో సహాయపడటానికి వారి సృజనాత్మకతను వెలికితీస్తారు.

programme.title: కౌంటింగ్ కార్స్
programme.sub-title: Danny Koker and his crew are fans of the coolest American cars and are involved in the restoration and modification of classic cars and bikes
programme.desc: అమెరికన్ కార్ల అభిమానులైన డానీ కోకర్, అతని సిబ్బంది క్లాసిక్ కార్లు, బైక్‌లను రిపేర్ చేసి, అందంగా తీర్చిదిద్దుతుంటారు.

credits.actor: Danny Koker,Kevin Mack,Mike \"Horny\" Henry,Ryan Evans,Shannon Aikau,Scott Jones

programme.title: అమెరికన్ రిస్టోరేషన్
programme.sub-title: A team of expert craftsmen brings old, worn-out antiques back to life, restoring vintage treasures while sharing the fascinating stories behind each unique item
programme.desc: నిపుణుల బృందం ఉద్యోగ సమయంలో అమెరికన్ పాతకాలపు వస్తువులను వాటి అసలు స్థితికి పునరుద్ధరించడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది.

credits.actor: Bodie Stroud,Dale Walksler,Andy Bowman Jr.,Steve Hale,Bob Halliday,Rick Dale,Tyler Dale

programme.title: ఫోర్జ్డ్ ఇన్ ఫైర్
programme.sub-title: Top bladesmiths from different walks of life compete to create the best weapons and prove their effectiveness in a series of daunting challenges
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ బ్లేడ్ స్మిత్‌లు ఉత్తమ ఆయుధాలను రూపొందించడానికి, కఠినమైన సవాళ్లలో వాటి సమర్థతను నిరూపించుకోవడానికి పోటీపడతారు.

credits.actor: Grady Powell,J. Neilson,Doug Marcaida,David Baker,Ben Abbott,Wil Willis,Jason Knight

programme.title: ది ఐన్‌స్టీన్ ఛాలెంజ్
programme.sub-title: Amado DeHoyas and Ed Miller are two aeronautical experts from NASA who explore various concepts from flight of a plane to stealth bombers
programme.desc: వివిధ రంగాలలోని ఇద్దరు నిపుణులు పిల్లల బృందానికి సంక్లిష్టమైన భావనలను వివరించడానికి ఒకరితో ఒకరు పోటీపడతారు.

programme.title: ద ఫాస్ట్ హిస్టరీ ఆఫ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sets on a fast-paced journey to look into the pasts of legendary companies to fascinating subjects like UFOs and the daily lives of billionaires
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు పురాణ కంపెనీల గతాన్ని పరిశీలించి, యూఎఫ్ఓలు, బిలియనీర్ల చరిత్రను తెలుసుకోడానికి ప్రయాణాన్ని ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది అన్‌బిలీవబుల్ విత్ డాన్ అక్రాయిడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker gives a comprehensive insight into the world's most peculiar stories from history, and diverse narratives from across various fields and cultures
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత డాన్ అక్రాయిడ్ యానిమేషన్ ద్వారా చరిత్రలోని ఎన్నో చిత్రవిచిత్రమైన, సమస్యాత్మక కథలను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: రాయల్ ఇండియా విత్ సమీరా
programme.sub-title: Renowned USA-based chef Samira Nanda explores the palaces of India in search of the culinary secrets of the nation's royal families
programme.desc: అమెరికాకు చెందిన చెఫ్ సమీరా నందా, దేశ రాజకుటుంబాల వంటకాల రహస్యాలను వెతుకుతూ భారతదేశంలోని రాజభవనాలను అన్వేషిస్తుంది.

programme.title: టూర్ డి రాయల్

programme.desc: ప్రముఖ మానసిక నిపుణుడు నీల్ మాధవ్ గుజరాత్, రాజస్థాన్ లోని విలాసవంతమైన రాజభవనాలు, అందమైన కోటలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.desc: பிரபல நிறுவனங்களின் கடந்த காலங்கள், யுஎஃப்ஒக்கள்-கோடீஸ்வரர்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை போன்ற விஷயங்களை பற்றி ஆராயும் ஒரு நபர்.

programme.title: ஹிஸ்ட்ரி'ஸ் க்ரேட்டஸ்ட் எஸ்கேப்ஸ் வித் மோர்கன் ஃப்ரீமேன்
programme.sub-title: Renowned actor and host Morgan Freeman revisits some of the most daring jailbreaks conducted by ingenuous prisoners from across the globe
programme.desc: உலகின் திறமையான கைதிகள் சிறையிலிருந்து தப்பும் தைரியமான முயற்சிகளை ஆராயும் நடிகரும் தொகுப்பாளருமான மார்கன் ஃப்ரீமேன்.

credits.actor: Morgan Freeman,Gary Brierley,Michael Dyke,Michael Esslinger,David Widner,Hugh Hunt

programme.title: அமெரிக்கன் பிக்கர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The hosts recycle and transform forgotten relics, old electronics and vehicles into beautiful collectibles while meeting other collectors
programme.desc: மறக்கப்பட்ட நினைவுச்சின்னங்கள், பழைய எலக்ட்ரானிக்ஸ் மற்றும் வாகனங்களை அழகான சேகரிப்புகளாக மாற்றும் தொகுப்பாளர்கள்.

credits.actor: Mike Wolfe,Frank Fritz,Danielle Colby-Cushman,Robbie Wolfe,Lauren Wray Grisham

programme.title: லைஃப் ஆஃப்ட்டர் பீப்பல்

programme.title: ஸ்மால் பட்ஜெட் பிக் மேக்ஓவர்

programme.title: கந்த குரு கவச்சம்

programme.title: உணர்வு
programme.sub-title: A man confronts powerful politicians and strives to fight against them, in an attempt to eliminate corruption from society
programme.desc: ஒரு மனிதன் சமூகத்திலிருந்து ஊழலை அகற்றும் முயற்சியில் சக்தி வாய்ந்த அரசியல்வாதிகளுக்கு எதிராக போராடுகிறான்.

programme.title: சினிமா சினிமா

programme.title: ரகசிய கேள்விகள்
programme.sub-title: Renowned sexologist Dr Kamaraj provides expert advice on issues like impotency and erectile dysfunction, while offering treatment recommendations tailored to individual needs
programme.desc: பாலியல் நிபுணர் டாக்டர் காமராஜ்,ஆண்மைக்குறைவு-விறைப்புத்தன்மை பிரச்சினைகளில் ஆலோசனைகளை வழங்கி, பரிந்துரைகளை அளிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: கல்யாண பரிசு
programme.sub-title: Geetha and Vasanthi are sisters who share a great bond of friendship. However, their lives turn upside down when they both fall in love with the same man
programme.desc: கீதா மற்றும் வசந்தி அன்பான சகோதரிகள். இருப்பினும், அவர்கள் இருவருமே ஒரே மனிதனை காதலித்ததால் அவர்கள் வாழ்க்கை மாறியது.

credits.actor: Gemini Ganesan,B. Saroja Devi,K. A. Thangavelu,Vijaya Kumari,M. Saroja,S. D. Subbulakshmi

programme.title: கண்மணியே பேசு
programme.sub-title: A married man reluctantly weds for a second time after his wife contracts a mental illness. However, his life turns upside down after his first wife gradually begins to recover from her illness
programme.desc: மனைவிக்கு மனநோய் ஏற்பட்டதால் தயக்கத்துடன் இரண்டாவது கல்யாணம் செய்யும் ஆணுக்கு முதல் மனைவி சரியாகும் போது குழப்பமாகிறது.

programme.title: அய்யா வழி சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Devotional artists and singers perform soulful hymns, celebrating Ayya Vaikundar, a 19th-century visionary and social reformer, inspiring faith and social change
programme.desc: பக்திப் பாடகர்கள் 19 ஆம் நூற்றாண்டின் தொலைநோக்கு பார்வையாளரான அய்யா வைகுண்டரைக் கொண்டாடி, பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders along with devotees recite morning prayers, conduct rituals and sing devotional songs in praise of various Hindu deities
programme.desc: மத தலைவர்கள் பக்தர்களுடன் காலை பிரார்த்தனைகளை ஓதி, சடங்குகளை நடத்தி, இந்து தெய்வங்களை போற்றி பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: இண்டியா சாங்க்
programme.sub-title: A group of experienced artists, musicians and singers perform a special patriotic song depicting the beauty, traditions and cultures of India
programme.desc: இந்தியாவின் அழகு, மரபுகள் மற்றும் கலாச்சாரங்களை சித்தரிக்கும் ஒரு சிறப்பு தேசபக்தி பாடலை நிகழ்த்தும் பாடகர்கள் குழு.

programme.title: கந்த சஷ்டி கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A melodious rendering of a hymn composed in praise of Lord Murugan is played in order to invoke the spirit of devotion
programme.desc: பக்தி உணர்வைத் தூண்டும் வகையில், முருகப் பெருமானைப் புகழ்ந்து இயற்றப்பட்ட ஒரு பாடலின் மெல்லிசைப் பாடல் இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: ஆலயதர்சனம்
programme.sub-title: The host shares information about the history and religious significance of various temples in the country to a gathering of devotees
programme.desc: நாட்டின் பல கோயில்களின் வரலாறு மற்றும் மத முக்கியத்துவம் பற்றிய தகவல்களை தொகுப்பாளர் பக்தர்களுக்கு பகிர்ந்து கொள்கிறார்.

programme.title: வெற்றிப்படிக்கட்டு
programme.sub-title: A motivational speaker provides a comprehensive and detailed insight into various important life lessons and moral values
programme.desc: ஊக்கமளிக்கும் பேச்சாளர் பல்வேறு முக்கியமான வாழ்க்கை பாடங்கள்-தார்மீக விழுமியங்களை பற்றிய விரிவான நுண்ணறிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents a compilation of the latest updates and developments pertaining to politics, sports, social and economic news
programme.desc: அரசியல், விளையாட்டு, சமூக மற்றும் பொருளாதாரச் செய்திகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: த லார்ட்'ஸ் சேலஞ்ச்
programme.sub-title: Joshua Daniel of Laymen's Evangelical Fellowship reads biblical passages, explains their significance and encourages devotees to have a personal relationship with the Almighty
programme.desc: லேமென்ஸ் எவாஞ்சலிகல் பெல்லோஷிப்பின் ஜோசுவா, வேதாகமத்தின் அதிகாரங்களை விளக்கி, கடவுளுடன் இணைந்திருக்க ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: தேனருவி
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection featuring pleasant and melodious songs from popular Tamil films of the classic era is played non-stop
programme.desc: பிரபலமான தமிழ்ப் பாரம்பரிய சகாப்தத்தின் இனிமையான மற்றும் மெல்லிசைப் பாடல்களைக் கொண்ட ஒரு விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: மியூசிக் ஷோ
programme.sub-title: Talented artists sing traditional and devotional songs, showcasing their cultural heritage and vocal prowess through soulful performances
programme.desc: பாரம்பரிய மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களை பாடி, கலாச்சார பாரம்பரியம் மற்றும் குரல் வளத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தும் திறமையான கலைஞர்கள்.

programme.title: ஓஷோ உலகம்
programme.sub-title: The host delves into the philosophy of Osho, an Indian mystic and philosopher, exploring his views on topics like happiness and spirituality, and their relevance to human life
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகவாதி-தத்துவஞானியுமான ஓஷோவின் தத்துவம், மகிழ்ச்சி மற்றும் ஆன்மீகம் போன்ற தலைப்புகளில் அவரது பார்வைகளை ஆராய்கிறது.

programme.title: டாக்டர் ஸ்ரீ வர்மா
programme.sub-title: A medical expert talks about various kinds of diseases and disorders and discusses in detail the different ways to prevent them

programme.sub-title: Religious scholar Brother Mathew Vattiprolu addresses a gathering of devotees and delivers a discourse in praise of the Almighty
programme.desc: మతప్రబోధకుడు బ్రదర్ మాథ్యూ వట్టిప్రోలు భక్తుల సమావేశాన్ని ఉద్దేశించి, యేసుని స్తుతిస్తూ ఒక ప్రసంగం ఇస్తారు.

programme.title: బ్రదర్ పి. జోషి
programme.sub-title: Brother P Joshi sheds light on the teachings from the Bible and exhorts devotees to follow the teachings of Jesus to lead a fulfilling life
programme.desc: బ్రదర్ పి.జోషి బైబిలులోని బోధనలు వివరిస్తూ,సంతోషకర జీవితాన్ని గడపడానికి యేసు బోధనలను అనుసరించాలని భక్తులకు ఉపదేశిస్తారు.

programme.title: డాక్టర్ ఎన్. జయపాల్
programme.sub-title: Dr N Jayapaul, a religious leader, shares important verses and teachings from the Bible and encourages followers to lead a righteous life

programme.title: రెవరెండ్ జోసెఫ్ కిషోర్
programme.sub-title: Reverend Joseph Kishore delivers sermons using parables from the Holy Bible and explains their spiritual significance to devotees

programme.title: డాక్టర్ పి సతీష్ కుమార్

programme.title: బ్రదర్ మోహన్ సి లాజరస్
programme.sub-title: A religious leader spreads the gospel of God and the teachings of the Bible to the followers and encourages them to take the path of spirituality

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்
programme.sub-title: At a revered temple in Kerala, priests and devotees unite in devotion, performing sacred rituals and offering heartfelt prayers to Lord Shiva
programme.desc: கேரளாவின் பிரபல கோவிலில், பூசாரிகள்-பக்தர்கள் இணைந்து, சடங்குகளை செய்து, சிவனுக்கு இதயப்பூர்வ வழிபாடுகளை செய்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கும்பாபிஷேகம்
programme.sub-title: Devotees in large numbers visit a temple to perform a special ritual in order to synergise and unite the special powers of the deity
programme.desc: தெய்வத்தின் சிறப்பு சக்திகளை ஒருங்கிணைக்கவும் ஒன்றிணைக்கவும் ஒரு சிறப்பு சடங்கை செய்ய பக்தர்கள் கோயிலுக்கு வருகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஆர்ஜேஆர் - ஹெர்பல் ஸ்லாட்
programme.sub-title: The host promotes the services offered by RJR Herbal Hospital, where patients receive Ayurvedic treatment to treat various health problems
programme.desc: நோயாளிகளுக்கு சிகிச்சையளிக்க ஆயுர்வேத சிகிச்சையை வழங்கும் ஆர்ஜேஆர் ஹெர்பல் மருத்துவமனை சேவைகளை விளம்பரப்படுத்துகிறது.

programme.title: டைம்லெஸ் தமிழ் நாடு
programme.sub-title: The presenter showcases Tamil Nadu's timeless allure and rich heritage, offering unforgettable experiences for visitors to explore and cherish
programme.desc: தமிழ்நாட்டின் அழியாத வசீகரம் மற்றும் செழுமையான பாரம்பரியத்தையும் ஆராயவும் போற்றவும் மறக்க முடியாத அனுபவங்களையும் அறிக.

programme.title: வர்ல்ட் ஸ்பாஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host visits the Gaya Island Resort, known for the serene beaches and coral reefs in its vicinity, and explores the marine park and spa therapies
programme.desc: மனம் மற்றும் உடலை புத்துயிரூட்டுவதற்கான பல்வேறு வகையான சிகிச்சை அளிக்கும் ஸ்பாக்களுக்கு வருகை தரும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: பேக்பேக் போர்ச்சுகல்
programme.sub-title: Driek visits the vineyards of Douro Valley, one of the oldest demarcated wine regions in the world
programme.desc: ஒயின் உற்பத்திப் பகுதியான டூரோ பள்ளத்தாக்கின் திராட்சை தோட்டங்களை காணும் ட்ரீக்.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु

programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: द जंगल बुक

programme.desc: தனது கட்டுப்பாட்டில் கிராமத்தை கையாள நினைக்கும் தைரியமான காளியம்மாளின் ஆட்சிக்கு முடிவுக்கட்டும் துணை கலெக்டரான இந்திரா.

programme.title: கிச்சன் கலாட்டா

programme.title: பூங்கொடி

programme.title: வணக்கம் தமிழா
programme.sub-title: The hosts interact with renowned personalities and also present the latest updates from across the globe, ranging from entertainment to technology
programme.desc: தொகுப்பாளர்கள் பிரபல ஆளுமைகளுடன் தொடர்பு கொண்டு, உலகம் முழுவதிலுமிருந்து சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகளையும் வழங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: அனுமன்
programme.sub-title: When Hanuman, an ordinary boy, is blessed with extraordinary powers, he sets out on an adventurous journey and conquers various obstacles
programme.desc: ஒரு சாதாரண சிறுவனான அனுமன், அசாதாரண சக்திகளால் ஆசீர்வதிக்கப்பட்டபோது, ​​அவர் சாகசப் பயணத்தை மேற்கொண்டு தடைகளை வென்றார்.

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல்
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, தங்கள் லட்சியங்களைத் தொடர ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஒரு பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கயல்
programme.sub-title: Kayal, a selfless woman, earns to provide for her family after her father abandons them. Despite being overwhelmed with responsibilities, she puts her loved ones' well-being before her own happiness
programme.desc: தந்தைக்கு பின் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளில் மூழ்கியுள்ள கயல், மகிழ்ச்சியை விட அன்புக்குரியவர்களின் நலனையே முன்னிறுத்துகிறாள்.

programme.title: கிச்சன் கலாட்டா
programme.sub-title: The host welcomes celebrity guests as they whip up their signature dishes alongside high-end chef creations, rustic village recipes and much more
programme.desc: விருந்தினர்கள் தங்களின் தனித்துவமான உணவுகளையும், சமையல் கலைஞர்களின் படைப்புகளையும், கிராமிய பாரம்பரிய சமையல் குறிப்புகளையும் மற்றும் பலவற்றையும் தயாரிக்கும்போது, ​​தொகுப்பாளர் அவர்களை வரவேற்கிறார்.

programme.title: பூங்கொடி
programme.sub-title: Poongodi's quest for self-establishment leads her to Saravanan, a man unwittingly controlled by his stepmother's manipulative ways
programme.desc: பூங்கொடியின் சுய தேடல் அவளை தன் மாற்றாந்தாயின் சூழ்ச்சிகளால் அறியாமலேயே கட்டுப்படும் சரவணனிடம் அழைத்துச் செல்கிறது.

programme.title: துளசி
programme.sub-title: A kind-hearted Tulasi strives hard to keep her family together and secure the happiness, well-being and future of her children at all costs
programme.desc: குடும்பத்தை ஒன்றாக வைத்துகொள்ளவும், குழந்தைகளின் மகிழ்ச்சி, நல்வாழ்வு மேலும் எதிர்காலத்தை பாதுகாக்கவும் பாடுபடும் துளசி.

programme.title: குறிஞ்சி
programme.sub-title: When circumstances compel an ambitious woman to wed a man with a tough personality, their initial friction slowly gives way to mutual understanding and eventually love
programme.desc: சூழ்நிலைகளின் நிர்ப்பந்தத்தால், லட்சியம் மிக்க ஒரு பெண், கடின குணமுடைய ஒரு ஆணை மணக்கிறாள். ஆரம்பகால முரண்பாடுகள் படிப்படியாக மறைந்து, பரஸ்பர புரிதலுக்கும் இறுதியில் காதலுக்கும் வழிவகுக்கிறது.

programme.title: அபிராமி
programme.sub-title: Abirami, a loving mother and devoted wife, places her family's happiness above all else. After enduring endless disrespect, she, with her daughter's support, sets out to rebuild her life
programme.desc: அன்பான தாயும் மனைவியுமான அபிராமி, தன் குடும்பத்தின் மகிழ்ச்சிக்கே முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறாள். எனினும், தொடர் அவமரியாதைகளை சந்தித்த பின், அவள் தன் மகளின் ஆதரவுடன் தன் வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் புதிதாகத் தொடங்குகிறாள்.

programme.title: சிறகுகள்
programme.sub-title: While weathering deep family turmoil, fate brings Dharmadurai and Parvathi together as they navigate greed and betrayal
programme.desc: கடினமான குடும்பச் சிக்கல்களைச் சமாளிக்கும் வேளையில், பேராசையையும் துரோகத்தையும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் தர்மதுரையையும் பார்வதியையும் விதி ஒன்று சேர்க்கிறது.

programme.title: இருமலர்கள்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: லக்ஷ்மி
programme.sub-title: Maha, her family's primary breadwinner, wants to keep supporting her family even after marrying Selvam. However, things become complicated as obstacles test their family bonds and marriage
programme.desc: மகா செல்வத்தை திருமணம் செய்தபிறகும், தாய் வீட்டை ஆதரிக்க நினைக்கும்போது, தடைகளால் அவர்களின் குடும்பத்தில் சிக்கலானது.

programme.title: மூவி டு பி அனௌன்ஸ்ட்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in cinema
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி சினிமாவில் மிகவும் சிறந்தவைகளைக் கொண்டுவருகின்றது.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host provides the latest information, advancements, and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues
programme.desc: அரசியல், பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூகப் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய தகவல்கள், முன்னேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: அன்னம்
programme.sub-title: Annam, a bright and cheerful young woman, faces the challenges of life while withstanding the harsh treatment from her stepmother
programme.desc: மகிழ்ச்சியான இளம் பெண் அன்னம், தனது மாற்றாந்தாயின் கொடுமைகளை சகித்துக்கொண்டு வாழ்க்கையின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

programme.title: பைரவி
programme.sub-title: Following the tragedy that claimed her family, Bhairavi's life falls apart as she begins anew in an uninviting house and job. But her aim to uncover the reality of the incident drives her onward
programme.desc: தன் குடும்பத்தை பறித்த துயர சம்பவத்தால் பைரவியின் வாழ்க்கை சிதறுகிறது. அன்னியமான வீட்டிலும் புதிய வேலையிலும் தன் வாழ்வைத் தொடங்கும் அவள், அந்தச் சம்பவத்தின் உண்மைகளைக் கண்டறியும் இலக்கோடு தொடர்ந்து முன்னோக்கிப் பயணிக்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மருமகள்
programme.sub-title: Prabhu is a miser and puts his needs ahead of his family. Circumstances bring him closer to Aadhirai, who helps others selflessly
programme.desc: பிரபு, தன் குடும்பத்தை விட தன் தேவைகளுக்கு முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறான். ஆதிரையிடம் தன்னலமின்றி மற்றவர்களுக்கு உதவுகிறாள்.

programme.title: மூன்று முடிச்சு
programme.sub-title: Nandini, a vivacious girl, gets married to Suryakumar, a businessman. However, the couple strives to navigate their relationship along with balancing familial responsibilities
programme.desc: தொழிலதிபர் சூர்யகுமாரை மணக்கும் சுறுசுறுப்பான நந்தினி,இருவரும் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளின் மூலம் உறவை வழிநடத்த முயலுகிறார்கள்.

credits.actor: Swathi Konde,Prabhakaran Chandran,Krithika Laddu,Niyaz Khan,Preethi Sanjiv

programme.title: சிங்கப்பெண்ணே
programme.sub-title: Anandi, a village belle, embarks on a solo journey to fulfil her duties as a daughter and shoulder the responsibilities of her family
programme.desc: ஒரு மகளாக தனது கடமைகளை நிறைவேற்றவும், தனது குடும்பத்தின் பொறுப்புகளை சுமப்பதற்காகவும் ஒரு பயணத்தை தொடங்கும் ஆனந்தி.

credits.actor: Darshak Gowda,Amaljith,G. Gnanasambandam,Rama,Chandrakanth,Lakshmi Raj,VJ Bavithra,Maneesha Mahesh

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல் தொடர்கிறது
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஆதிமுத்து குணசேகரனின் வீழ்ச்சியைத் தொடர்ந்து, ​​தங்கள் லட்சிய பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகின்றனர்.

credits.actor: Madhumitha Hirannaiah,Kaniha,Haripriya Isai,Vela Ramamoorthy,Sabari Prasanth,Vibhu Raman

programme.title: மல்லி
programme.sub-title: Adi Kesava experiences a tragedy, after which he takes in Mallika for his son. However, will Mallika be able to adjust in her new family?
programme.desc: ஆதி கேசவா என்பவர் ஒரு துயர சம்பவத்தை சந்திக்கிறார், அதன் பிறகு மல்லிகாவை தனது மகனுக்காக ஏற்றுக்கொள்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Sirisha Sougandh,Roopa Reddy,Bhavana Lasya,Aryan Dhir Kumar,Nanda Kishore,Jayasri Raj

programme.title: புது வசந்தம்
programme.sub-title: While the parents search for a suitable prospect for their daughter Selvi's marriage, she expresses her desire to get married to a joint family
programme.desc: பெற்றோர் தனக்கு திருமணத்திற்கு வரன் தேடும்போது, கூட்டுக் குடும்பத்தில் திருமணம் செய்ய விருப்பம் தெரிவிக்கும் செல்வி.

programme.title: శ్రీ లలితా సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Professional singers perform a rendition of a devotional song, reciting the thousand names of Goddess Lalita, seeking her blessings
programme.desc: వృత్తిపరమైన గాయకులు లలితాదేవి వెయ్యి నామాలను పఠిస్తూ భక్తి గీతాన్ని ఆలపిస్తూ, ఆమె ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరుకుంటారు.

programme.title: గణపతి స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Several devotees gather to chant the Ganpati Stotram, a devotional chant, in praise of Lord Ganesha and seek his blessings
programme.desc: అనేకమంది భక్తులు కలిసి భక్తి శ్లోకమైన గణపతి స్తోత్రంతో వినాయకుడిని ఆరాధిస్తూ, స్వామి ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరతారు.

programme.title: యాదాద్రి సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: Hindu priests and devotees chant a comprehensive compilation of hymns in praise of Yadagiri Laxmi Narasimha Swamy to seek the blessings of the Almighty
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు యాదగిరి లక్ష్మీ నరసింహస్వామిని స్తుతిస్తూ ఆయన దీవెనలు పొందేందుకు కీర్తనల సంకలనాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: కాకడ హారతి
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees gather together to sing devotional hymns and perform sacred rituals in honour of Shirdi Sai Baba
programme.desc: షిర్డీ సాయిబాబా గౌరవార్థం ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు ఒకచోట చేరి శ్లోకాలు పఠిస్తూ, పవిత్రమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: In veneration of Lord Venkateswara, devotees and priests listen to devotional songs and perform religious customs in order to seek his blessings
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర స్వామివారి కృపాకటాక్షాలు కోరుతూ మతపరమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహించి, భక్తి గీతాలు ఆలపిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Devotees recite the Sri Vishnu Sahasranama Stotram, in the name of Lord Vishnu to seek blessings and lead a better prosperous life
programme.desc: భక్తులు మెరుగైన, సంపన్న జీవితాన్ని ప్రసాదించమని కోరుతూ, విష్ణువు నామాలతో కూడిన విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: గణేశ సహస్రనామం
programme.sub-title: An in-depth collection of sacred texts and devotional hymns in praise of Lord Ganesha, to encourage devotees to seek his blessings
programme.desc: వినాయకుడి ఆశీస్సులు కోరుతూ భక్తులకు స్తుతులు, ప్రార్థనలను అందించే శ్లోకాలు, భక్తి గీతాల సమగ్ర సంకలనం ప్రసారం.

programme.title: గణపతి అభిషేకం

programme.desc: ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు గ్రంథాలలోని పవిత్ర శ్లోకాలను పఠిస్తూ వినాయకుడికి హిందూ ఆచారమైన అభిషేకాన్ని నిర్వహిస్తారు.

programme.title: సుబ్రహ్మణ్య అష్టోత్తరం

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस

programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़

programme.title: லைஃப் ஆஃப் அ ப்ரெடேட்டர்
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: சர்வைவிங் ஆஸ்திரேலியா
programme.sub-title: Experts examine the hazards of the Australian shoreline and the risks of deeper waters, while survivors share close encounters with dangerous marine predators
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வனப்பகுதியிலிருந்து தப்பிப் பிழைத்தவர்களின் அனுபவங்களையும், அங்கு உயிர் பிழைக்கத் தேவையான நடைமுறை உத்திகளையும் இந்த ஆவணப்படம் விவரிக்கிறது.

programme.title: சர்ச் ஃபார் தி கிங் கோப்ரா
programme.sub-title: Austin Stevens, a photographer and herpetologist, travels to the remote jungles of Southern India in pursuit of the world's largest venomous snake, the king cobra
programme.desc: ஆஸ்டின் ஸ்டீவன்ஸ், உலகின் மிகப்பெரிய விஷப் பாம்பான ராஜ நாகத்தைத் தேடி தென்னிந்தியாவின் தொலைதூரக் காடுகளுக்கு செல்கிறார்.

programme.title: ப்ரதர்ஹூட் ஆஃப் லயன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves
programme.desc: கென்யா மசாய் மாரா காட்டில் சிங்கங்களின் வாழ்க்கை, அவை எதிர்கொள்ளும் வேட்டையாடுதல் மற்றும் வாழ்விட இழப்பு பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: Super snakes
programme.desc: Snakes are a feature of nearly every culture in the world. 100,000 people die every year because of them. But we also owe our survival to snake predation on rodents. They attract a mythology which sometimes leaves the truth eating dust.

programme.title: லைஃப் ஆஃப் அ ப்ரெடேட்டர்
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: ரேஸ் ஆஃப் லைஃப்
programme.sub-title: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals adapt through a series of small, random mutations and usually do so in order to compete more effectively for food, water and space. Crocodiles are certainly of an ancient lineage, they are believed to be 200 million years old. Sharks have gone through the process of adaptation and evolutionary experimentation as well
programme.desc: சூழலில் தழுவி, விலங்குகளிடமிருந்து தங்களை பாதுகாக்க காலப்போக்கில் உருவாகிய பல்வேறு உயிரினங்களை பற்றி கூறும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: லைஃப் ஆஃப் அ ப்ரெடேட்டர்

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels

programme.title: Super snakes
programme.desc: Snakes are a feature of nearly every culture in the world. 100,000 people die every year because of them. But we also owe our survival to snake predation on rodents. They attract a mythology which sometimes leaves the truth eating dust.

programme.desc: தென்னாப்பிரிக்காவின் கொடிய பன்னிரண்டு பாம்புகளை தேடி, தவறாக அறியப்படும் அவற்றின் மதிப்பை கற்பிக்கும் குர்ட் கிரீன்வுட்.

programme.title: ப்ரதர்ஹூட் ஆஃப் லயன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: While the lion cubs at the Masai Mara Reserve prey on buffalo, one of them emerges to assert themselves as the dominant leader to guide the pride in attacking their victim
programme.desc: கென்யா மசாய் மாரா காட்டில் சிங்கங்களின் வாழ்க்கை, அவை எதிர்கொள்ளும் வேட்டையாடுதல் மற்றும் வாழ்விட இழப்பு பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: அட்டன்பரோ'ஸ் லைஃப் இன் கலர்
programme.sub-title: In India, peacocks dazzle females with magnificent tail feathers; a tiny hummingbird in the deserts of North America unfurls his spectacular headdress as he dances for a mate; and in the darkness of a rainforest, powerful mandrill baboons signal their status with red and blue face masks, while tiny frogs warn of deadly poisons with brilliant colours
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the vital role that colour plays in the daily life of various species. For us humans, it is a source of aesthetic beauty and expression, but for animals it is an essential tool used for survival and without it, there would be catastrophic consequences. Colours help animals to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies. Attenborough explores nature's use of colour using technological advancements in camera equipment to reveal the world, as seen by animals.

programme.title: டைகர்ஃபிஷ்: ஆஃப்ரிக்கா'ஸ் பிரான்னா
programme.sub-title: Tigerfish are terrifying freshwater predators. Extreme angler Andy Coetzee undertakes a hazardous journey to study the giant-sized species in their habitat in the Congo
programme.desc: மீன் இனமான டைகர்ஃபிஷின் நடத்தையை ஆய்வு செய்வதற்காக ஒரு பாதுகாவலர் ஆப்பிரிக்காவின் ஆறுகள் வழியாக பயணம் செய்கிறார்.

programme.title: ஆஸ்ஸி ஸ்னேக் வ்ராங்க்ளர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Chris and Stu come face-to-face with a giant red-bellied black snake that's taking shelter in a car's engine. In South Australia, Mick and Adele are helping local snake catcher, Dan, with one of his busiest snake catching seasons on record
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வீடுகளில் மறைந்திருக்கும் உலகின் கொடிய பாம்புகளை பிடிக்க முயலுகையில் ஆபத்துகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் நிபுணர்கள்.
