programme.title: த ஜூ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: பிராங்க்ஸ் மிருகக்காட்சிசாலையில் விலங்குகளின் பராமரிப்பு, அழியும் உயிரினங்களை காப்பதில் ஊழியரின் அர்ப்பணிப்பை அறிக.

programme.title: க்ரிகீ! இட்'ஸ் த இர்வினிஸ்
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: விலங்குகளை கவனித்துக்கொள்ள ஆஸ்திரேலிய பூங்காவில் வேலை செய்யும் இர்வின் குடும்பத்தினர் பல போராட்டங்களை எதிர்கொள்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: ஜுவல்ஸ் ஆஃப் த நேச்சுரல் வர்ல்ட்

programme.title: த ஜூ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: பிராங்க்ஸ் மிருகக்காட்சிசாலையில் விலங்குகளின் பராமரிப்பு, அழியும் உயிரினங்களை காப்பதில் ஊழியரின் அர்ப்பணிப்பை அறிக.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: ரிவர் மான்ஸ்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Jeremy Wade is not a fisherman; he's an `extreme angler' in search of the biggest and most dangerous freshwater fish, the kind with a taste for human flesh. This action-adventure series also features Wade illustrating how these river monsters are constructed to kill
programme.desc: நாட்டுப்புற கதைகள், புதிர்களை தகர்த்து நன்னீர் கண்டுபிடிப்பு இரகசியங்களை பற்றி உயிரியலாளர் ஜெர்மி வெட்ட வெளியிடுகிறார்.

programme.title: க்ரிகீ! இட்'ஸ் த இர்வினிஸ்
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions

programme.title: வைல்ட் பை நேச்சர்
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: பல வாழ்விடங்கள் மற்றும் விலங்குகளை ஆராய்ந்து, அவற்றைப் பற்றிய சுவாரஸ்யமான உண்மைகளை பகிரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலரான ஆர்துரோ.

The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: விலங்குகளை கவனித்துக்கொள்ள ஆஸ்திரேலிய பூங்காவில் வேலை செய்யும் இர்வின் குடும்பத்தினர் பல போராட்டங்களை எதிர்கொள்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: இண்டு த வைல்ட்: இண்டியா
programme.sub-title: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive
programme.desc: இந்தியாவின் கட்டுப்பாடற்ற நிலப்பரப்புகளில் வசிக்கும் பல்வேறு வனவிலங்குகளை ஆராய்ந்து விவரிக்கும் இயக்குனர் .

programme.title: த ஜூ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: பிராங்க்ஸ் மிருகக்காட்சிசாலையில் விலங்குகளின் பராமரிப்பு, அழியும் உயிரினங்களை காப்பதில் ஊழியரின் அர்ப்பணிப்பை அறிக.

programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పకడమ్ పకడై - ధమాకేదార్ ఇన్‌వెన్షన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in cinema
programme.desc: సినిమా రంగంలోని అత్యుత్తమమైన సినిమాలను కొన్నింటిని అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ బెర్నీ
programme.sub-title: Accompanied by his best friend Bernie, a hermit crab, Zig, a hyena, embarks on a series of schemes to capture Marina, a mermaid. But his plans are thwarted by a cunning shark
programme.desc: మత్యకన్య మెరీనాను పట్టుకోడానికి తన ప్రాణమిత్రుడైన బెర్నీతో కలిసి జిగ్ అనే హైనా చేసే కుట్రలను ఒక షార్క్ అడ్డుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ
programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe
programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.title: భూత్ బంధుస్ ఇన్ సూపర్ ఘోస్ట్ కార్నివాల్‌
programme.sub-title: Chaos breaks out when the family of ghosts led by Colonel Suri takes part in the Super Ghost Carnival and meets a veteran's spirit that poses as an enemy
programme.desc: కల్నల్ సూరి దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం సూపర్ ఘోస్ట్ కార్నివాల్‌లో పాల్గొని, ఒక మాజీ సైనికుడి ఆత్మను కలవడంతో గందరగోళం చెలరేగుతుంది.

programme.title: డోరేమాన్ మూవీ: తూఫాని అడ్వెంచర్
programme.sub-title: After an old wizard is freed from a mysterious tomb, Doraemon, a robotic cat, and Nobita Nobi, a pre-teen boy, go to the Wind Village to prevent any mishaps there
programme.desc: రోబో పిల్లి డోరేమాన్, నోబితా నోబి అనే బాలుడు సమాధి నుండి విముక్తి పొందిన మాంత్రికుడి నుండి విండ్ గ్రామాన్ని కాపాడతారు.

credits.actor: Nobuyo Ohyama (Doraemon),Noriko Ohara (Nobita Nobi),Michiko Nomura (Shizuka Minamoto),Kaneta Kimotsuki (Suneo Honegawa),Kazuya Tatekabe (Takeshi Gouda),Mika Kanai (Fukko)

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: పకడమ్ పకడై - ధమాకేదార్ ఇన్‌వెన్షన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in cinema
programme.desc: సినిమా రంగంలోని అత్యుత్తమమైన సినిమాలను కొన్నింటిని అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ
programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe
programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.title: ది భూత్ బంధుస్: ఖాలీ దిమాగ్ షైతాన్ కా ఘర్
programme.sub-title: A ghost spirit possesses Happy, and Pinaki must defeat it in three challenges within 30 minutes to save his friend
programme.desc: భూత్‌కాల్ అనే దెయ్యం హ్యాపీని ఆవహించగా, తన మిత్రుడిని కాపాడుకోవడానికి పినాకి 30 నిమిషాల్లో మూడు సవాళ్లలో ఆ దెయ్యాన్ని ఓడించాల్సి ఉంటుంది.

programme.title: డోరేమాన్: నోబితాస్ సీక్రెట్ గాడ్జెట్ మ్యూజియం
programme.sub-title: The story revolves around a robotic cat named Doraemon, who travels back in time from the 22nd century to aid a pre-teen boy named nobita nobi
programme.desc: నోబితా నోబి అనే బాలుడికి సహాయం చేయడానికి 22వ శతాబ్దం నుండి కాల ప్రయాణం చేసిన డోరేమాన్ అనే రోబోటిక్ పిల్లి చుట్టూ తిరిగే కథ.

credits.actor: Wasabi Mizuta (Doraemon),Megumi Ohara (Nobita Nobi),Yumi Kakazu (Shizuka Minamoto),Tomokazu Seki (Suneo Honekawa),Subaru Kimura (Takeshi Goda),Chiaki (Dorami),Osamu Mukai (Osaru Mukashi),Ken Matsudaira (Mustard)

programme.desc: एक प्रतिभाशाली युवा शेफ मन्नत, बड़े सपने देखती है लेकिन उसकी नियोक्ता ऐश्वर्या के रूप में उसके सामने बड़ी बाधा आती है। दोनों अंजान है, कि ऐश्वर्या मन्नत की माँ भी है जिसने उसे जन्म के समय छोड़ा था।.

programme.title: मंजुलिका रिटर्न्स 2
programme.sub-title: Four strangers across different walks of life serendipitously meet at a haunted graveyard. However, luck turns to misery when an insidious force awakens
programme.desc: जीवन के विभिन्न क्षेत्रों से जुड़े चार अजनबी संयोगवश एक प्रेतवाधित कब्रिस्तान में मिलते हैं। हालाँकि, जब वहाँ एक दुष्ट आत्मा के जाग जाने उनकी जिंदगी में दुख दस्तक देता है।.

programme.title: जानदार
programme.sub-title: An orphaned Jai falls into a life of crime after a local gangster offers him shelter. However, a rift emerges between Jai and the gangster's son when the latter kills an innocent woman
programme.desc: अनाथ जय, गैंगस्टर के आश्रय दिए जाने के बाद अपराध की दुनिया में कदम रखता है। हालांकि, जब गैंगस्टर का बेटा निर्दोष महिला की हत्या कर देता है, तो जय और उसके बीच दरार पैदा हो जाती है।.

programme.title: डीके बोस
programme.sub-title: DK Bose is a corrupt police officer who conducts himself with confidence and bravado. However, a surprising series of events forces him to turn over a new leaf
programme.desc: डीके बोस एक भ्रष्ट पुलिस अधिकारी, पूरे आत्मविश्वास और बहादुरी के साथ काम करता है। हालाँकि, घटनाओं का एक हैरान कर देने वाला सिलसिला उसे सुधरने और एक नया जीवन शुरू करने पर मजबूर कर देता है।.

credits.actor: Sundeep Kishan (DK Bose),Nisha Agarwal (Manisha),Sampath Raj (Mirchi Ganga),Sapthagiri (Sapthagiri),Ajay Ghosh (SP),Nanaji (Nanaji),Ravi Varma (DSP),Sattanna (Constable)

programme.title: घमंडी
programme.sub-title: Sachein and Shalini, who study in the same college, become close friends after he saves her injured father during an accident. However, their egos do not allow them to disclose their feelings
programme.desc: दुर्घटना में शालिनी के घायल पिता को बचाने के बाद, कॉलेज में पढ़ते सचिन और शालिनी घनिष्ठ मित्र बन जाते हैं। हालाँकि, उनका अहंकार उन्हें अपनी भावनाओं को प्रकट करने से रोकने लगता है।.

programme.desc: पुलिस इंस्पेक्टर विक्रम को उस वरिष्ठ अधिकारी के हत्यारे को पकड़ने का काम सौंपा जाता है, जिसने समीरा के साथ कथित तौर पर बलात्कार किया है। जाँच शुरू करने पर वह कई स्याह रहस्यों का सामना करता है।.

programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies

programme.title: లెస్ లియో రైస్ ఆఫ్ సూపర్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, a young but ferocious policeman and his friends set out on an adventure with their friends in order to fight the evil forces
programme.desc: ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం, అతడి స్నేహితులు కలిసి దుష్ట శక్తులతో పోరాడుతూ, అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: బాహుబలి ఫ్రెండ్స్ ఔర్ వ్యోమాసుర్ కి మ్యాజికల్ బుక్
programme.sub-title: When an evil villain called Vyomasaur obtains a magical book, he uses it to cause havoc in the world. However, Little Singham and Bahubali Friends join forces to defeat him
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, బాహుబలి స్నేహితులు కలిసి ప్రపంచంలో విధ్వంసం సృష్టించాలనుకునే దుష్ట వ్యోమాసుర్‌ను ఓడించాలనుకుంటారు.

programme.title: ఆర్ఆర్ఆర్5 లిటిల్ సింగం అండ్ ఛోటా భీమ్ సూర్యవంశీ యోధ
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces to defeat the rising evil with their tactics and bring back happiness to their lands
programme.desc: ఛోటా భీమ్, లిటిల్ సింగం కలిసి తమ వ్యూహాలతో పెరుగుతున్న చెడుని అంతం చేసి, భూమిపై ఆనందం తీసుకురావడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ ఔర్ లిటిల్ సింగం - ఐస్ ఏజ్ కా ఆతంక్
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces as they embark on a new mission on frozen islands to fight against the mighty icy monsters
programme.desc: ఛోటా భీమ్, లిటిల్ సింగం కలిసి ఘనీభవించిన దీవులలో శక్తివంతమైన మంచు రాక్షసులతో పోరాడటానికి ఒక మిషన్‌ను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

programme.title: మల్టీవర్స్ మే దోబారా
programme.sub-title: Little Singham and his friends journey across the multiverse, enduring perils and striving to keep the nefarious forces of evil at bay

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ ఇన్ సమయ్ చక్ర
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and his team protect a glacier cave from evil, but when things go wrong, they must travel back in time to save their friend
programme.desc: హిమానీనద గుహను కాపాడిన ఛోటా భీమ్, అతడి బృందం పరిస్థితులు తలక్రిందులైనప్పుడు స్నేహితుడిని కాపాడడానికి వెనక్కి వెళతారు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ ఢోలక్‌పూర్ కి దాస్తాన్
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and his friends face a new challenge as chaos strikes Dholakpur. Soon, they must travel far north in search of answers and save their beloved village from destruction
programme.desc: దెబ్బతిన్న కళాఖండాన్ని పునరుద్ధరించడానికి, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ను కాపాడటానికి ఛోటా భీమ్, అతని స్నేహితులు ప్రమాదంలో పడతాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem and his friends flee the time rift and reach Dholakpur, where villains live as regular people. Soon, they begin to recover their memories and identities, forcing Bheem to engage in a battle

programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: సంపత్ చంపత్
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: సంపత్, చంపత్ అనే ఇద్దరు చేతకాని దొంగలు నిరంతరం స్థానిక పోలీసుల చిక్కుల్లో పడే హాస్యభరితమైన సాహసాలను అనుసరించండి.

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: సంపన్న వారసుడైన తొమ్మిదేళ్ల ఓమి, జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే సరదా, ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన పరిస్థితుల ద్వారా జీవిత సత్యాలు తెలుసుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies
programme.desc: నిజాయితీపరుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం అన్యాయానికి వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడుతూ, శత్రువుల నుండి తన పట్టణాన్ని కాపాడతాడు.

credits.actor: Swapnil Kumari,Jigna Bharadhwaj,Sonal Kaushal,Neshma Chemburkar,Ganessh Divekar,Shaily Dubey,Saumya Daan,Anamaya Verma,Sumrridhi Shukla

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: Material Witness
programme.desc: The FBI suspects' fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

credits.actor: Mark Joy (Donald Nash),Carl Burrows,Keith Michael Gregory,Michael McKennitt,Tim L. Smith

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. \"Monsters and Mysteries in America\" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.desc: Real-life criminal cases prosecuted by attorneys.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

credits.actor: Hiba Nawab,Nikhil Khurana,Anup Upadhyay,Soma Rathod,Harveer Singh,Raashi Bawa,Firoz Khan,Naveen Bawa,Saheb Das Manikpuri

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.sub-title: A trio of chickens resides on a lively farm. Meanwhile, two mischievous weasels from a chaotic junkyard plot to make a meal out of them
programme.desc: एक खेत में रहने वाली मुर्गियों की एक तिकड़ी को एक अव्यवस्थित कबाड़खाने में रहने वाले दो शरारती नेवले अपना भोजन बनाने की योजना बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: पीटर पैन
programme.sub-title: Peter Pan embarks on various adventures with his friends to fight the evil Captain Hook and his pirates and save Neverland
programme.desc: पीटर पैन एक दुष्ट कैप्टन हुक और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं से लड़ने और नेवरलैंड्स को बचाने के लिए अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: जीजाजी छत पर हैं
programme.sub-title: Pancham and Pintu disguise themselves as a married couple in a desperate attempt to find a house and succeed in renting Murari's attic. However, Murari's daughter, Elaichi, learns about their secret
programme.desc: पंचम और पिंटू किराए के मकान के लिए मुरारी के सामने पति-पत्नी होने का नाटक करते हैं। हालांकि, मुरारी की बेटी इलायची को उनके रहस्य के बारे में पता चल जाता है।.

credits.actor: Hiba Nawab,Nikhil Khurana,Anup Upadhyay,Naveen Bawa,Raashi Bawa,Harveer Singh,Yogesh Tripathi

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: रॉबिनहुड
programme.sub-title: After Baron Alwyn's men set fire to the palace of the Huntingtons, young Robert, along with his friend and sisters, seeks refuge in Sherwood Forest. There, they meet the leader of a group of outlaws
programme.desc: बैरन एल्विन के आदमियों द्वारा हंटिंगटन के महल में आग लगाने के बाद, रॉबर्ट अपने दोस्त और बहनों के साथ शेरवुड फ़ॉरेस्ट में शरण लेता है। वहाँ, वे डाकूओं के एक समूह के नेता से मिलते हैं।.

programme.title: ஆசை 100 வகை
programme.sub-title: A series of dramatised re-enactments of cases revolving around various horrifying and unscrupulous activities that conspire in society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தில் சதி செய்யும் பல்வேறு திகிலூட்டும் மற்றும் நேர்மையற்ற செயல்களைச் சுற்றியுள்ள வழக்குகளின் தொடர்ச்சியான நாடகமாக்கப்பட்ட மறு-நடவடிக்கைகள்.

programme.title: மிக்ஸ்டேப் பாடல்கள்

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: வானம்பாடி
programme.sub-title: Two sisters, Thulasi and Manasi, face a fork in the road with impending difficulties when one of them chooses to marry the son of their father's enemy
programme.desc: சகோதரிகளான துளசி மற்றும் மானசியில் ஒருத்தி தங்கள் தந்தையினுடைய எதிரி மகனை மணக்கத் தீர்மானிக்கும்போது, வரவிருக்கும் சிக்கல்களுடன் கூடிய ஒரு திருப்புமுனையை அவர்கள் எதிர்கொள்கிறார்கள்.

programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: கூண்டுக்கிளி
programme.sub-title: Balasudha's life comes to a halt as she sacrifices her happiness when her family loses all their wealth and properties and is forced to shift into a rental house
programme.desc: பாலசுதவின் குடும்பம் செல்வம் மற்றும் சொத்துக்கள் என அனைத்தையும் இழந்து, வாடகை வீட்டிற்க்கு குடிபெயர வேண்டிய கட்டாயத்திற்கு வரும்போது, அவளோ தன் மகிழ்ச்சியை தியாகம் செய்வது அவளது வாழ்வு குலைகிறது.

programme.title: அலாதின்

programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: அம்மு
programme.sub-title: Anupama, a schoolchild, lives happily with her mother and her elder sister. However, she goes through many problems trying to figure out her father's identity
programme.desc: பள்ளி மாணவியான அனுபமா, தன் தாய் மற்றும் அக்காவுடன் மகிழ்ச்சியாக வாழ்கிறாள். இருப்பினும், தன் தந்தையை பற்றிய உண்மையை கண்டறிய முயற்சிக்கும்போது அவள் பல சிக்கல்களைச் சந்திக்கிறாள்.

credits.actor: Vinaya Prasad,Malavika Wales,Srinish Aravind,Subash Balakrishnan,Baby Keshiya,Preetha Pradeep

programme.title: அலாதின்
programme.desc: Aladdin, a poor thief, discovers a magical lamp containing a Genie. However, soon he realizes that Zafar, an evil sorcerer, also desires the lamp to rule over Baghdad.

programme.title: जमाई राजा
programme.sub-title: When the wealthy Durgeshwari's daughter falls in love with Raja, a poor boy, she reluctantly agrees to their union. However, she constantly tries to sabotage their relationship, but Raja outwits her
programme.desc: अमीर दुर्गेश्वरी की बेटी, रेखा को गरीब राजा से प्यार होता है और वह उससे शादी करना चाहती है। दुर्गेश्वरी का मानना है कि उसे उससे भी अच्छा लड़का मिलेगा, इसलिए वो उन्हें अलग करने की कोशिश करती है।.

credits.actor: Hema Malini (Durgeshwari Devi),Anil Kapoor (Raja),Madhuri Dixit (Rekha),Anupam Kher (Din Dayal Trivedi),Satish Kaushik (Bankhe Bihari Chaturvedi),Shakti Kapoor (Shakti)

programme.title: घर एक मन्दिर
programme.sub-title: Brothers Prem, Vijay and Ravi are happy, but their lives change when Prem gets killed. Ravi must save his family from an evil man, Dharampal, while Vijay is preoccupied with Sapna
programme.desc: प्रेम, विजय और रवि अपने घर को प्यार का मंदिर मानते हैं। हालाँकि, उनका जीवन बदलता है, जब प्रेम की हत्या होती है और विजय, सपना के प्यार में अंधा हो जाता है।.

credits.actor: Shashi Kapoor,Moushumi Chatterjee,Mithun Chakraborty,Raj Kiran,Ranjeeta Kaur,Shoma Anand,Suresh Oberoi,Kader Khan,Shakti Kapoor,Prem Chopra,Asrani,Aruna Irani

programme.title: गीत
programme.sub-title: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her
programme.desc: लोकप्रिय गायिका,नेहा को पूर्व प्रबंधक द्वारा जहर दिया जाता है जिससे उसके स्वरतन्त्री को नुकसान पहुंचता है।वह एक गाँव में स्थानांतरित होती है जहां वह राजेश से मिलती है जो उसकी मदद करनेका फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Avinash Wadhavan (Raja),Divya Bharati (Neha),Laxmikant Berde (Pandey),Dharmesh Tiwari,Anil Dhawan (Doctor),Shravani Goswami (Pandey's Wife)

programme.title: जीवन धारा
programme.sub-title: Sangeeta, a young woman, decides to sacrifice her dreams and work relentlessly to provide for her family after her father abandons them
programme.desc: युवती संगीता के पिता अपने परिवार का त्याग करते हैं, जिसके बाद वह अपने सपनों को भूलकर अपने परिवार का भरण-पोषण करने के लिए परिश्रम करती है।.

credits.actor: Rekha (Sangeeta Shrivastav),Amol Palekar (Anand Bhatnagar),Raj Babbar (Ashok Kumar Shrivastav),Kanwaljit Singh (Prem Kumar Verma),Simple Kapadia (Kalpana Malhotra),Madhu Kapoor (Geeta Shrivastav),Sulochana Latkar (Sangeeta's mother),Padma Chavan (Sadhana Malhortra),Rakesh Roshan (Kanwal Pal Singh),Suresh Chatwal (Roop Kumar),Karan Razdan (Bus conductor)

programme.title: बारह आना
programme.sub-title: Three roommates decide to solve their financial struggles by going down the path of crime and kidnapping people for small ransoms
programme.desc: अपनी जीवन शैली में सुधार करने के क्रम में तीन लोग गलती से अपराध की दुनिया में प्रवेश करते हैं और उन्हे पता चलता हैं यह बुरा व्यापार नहीं है।.

credits.actor: Naseeruddin Shah,Vijay Raaz,Arjun Mathur,Tannishtha Chatterjee,Violante Placido,Benjamin Gilani,Jayati Bhatia,Mahabanoo Mody-Kotwal

programme.title: जिगरिया
programme.sub-title: Shaamu, who lives a carefree life, falls in love with a well-educated girl, Raadha. However, circumstances force the young couple to part ways
programme.desc: शामू, जो अपना सारा दिन निष्फल काम करने में खर्च करता है, जो एक शिक्षित महिला, राधा के साथ प्यार में पड़ता है। हालांकि, परिस्थितिया इस जोड़े को अलग होने के लिए मजबूर करती है।.

credits.actor: Harshvardhan Deo (Shaamu),Cherry Mardia (Raadha),Veerendra Saxena (Shammu's father),K.K. programme.title: अन्नदाता
programme.sub-title: When Amba Prasad realises the harsh truth that his relatives just care for his money, he leaves home. Upon reaching a village, he meets Arun and Aarti and his life changes forever
programme.desc: एक अमीर आदमी का उसके लालची रिश्तेदारों द्वारा मोहभंग होता है और वह उसका घर छोड़ कर दूर भटकने लगता है। उसे आरती के रूप में सच्चा सुख मिलता है, जो साधारण लोगों के बीच एक छोटे से शहर में रहती है।.

credits.actor: Jaya Bhaduri,Anil Dhawan,Om Prakash,Krishnakant,Dulari,Shamim,Asit Sen,Brahm Bhardwaj

programme.title: डिस्को डांसर
programme.sub-title: A slum-dwelling performer finds a new calling as a rising disco star. However, things take an unfortunate turn when an enemy from the past reappears in his life
programme.desc: अनिल की माँ पर चोरी का झूठा आरोप लगाकर उन्हें जेल भेज दिया जाता है। सालों बाद, वह प्रसिद्ध कलाकार बनता है और अपनी माँ का खोया सम्मान लौटाता है। लेकिन उसकी प्रसिद्धि उसके लिए कई दुश्मन बनाती है।.

credits.actor: Mithun Chakraborty (Anil/Jimmy),Kim (Rita Oberoi),Kalpana Iyer (Nikki Brown),Om Puri (David Brown),Geeta Kak (Radha),Yusuf Khan (Vasco),Bob Christo (Hitman),Jankidas (Stage Show Producer),Gauri Verma (Dolly Khandelwal)

programme.title: पाकीज़ा
programme.sub-title: Sahibjaan, a young courtesan, falls in love with Salim. The two wish to marry, but the nature of her profession keeps casting a dark shadow over their plans
programme.desc: साहिबजान, एक युवा वेश्या, सलीम से प्रेम करने लगती है। दोनों विवाह करना चाहते हैं, लेकिन उसका काम इसमें सबसे बड़ी मुश्किल खड़ी कर देता है।.

credits.actor: Meena Kumari,Raaj Kumar,Ashok Kumar,Veena,Chandabai,Pratima Devi,Lotan,Nadira,Praveen Paul,Zebunissa

programme.title: एक्सीडेन्ट ऑन हिल रोड
programme.sub-title: Sonam's night of celebration turns into a disaster when her car hits an innocent man. Afraid of being punished for the crime, she decides to hide him but invites trouble in turn
programme.desc: एक कार दुर्घटना में सोनम द्वारा राह चलते आदमी, प्रकाश की हत्या हो जाती है और उसकी लाश को घर लेकर आती है। अपने प्रेमी की मदद से वह उसकी लाश को ठिकाने लगाती है पर कई समस्यायें खड़ी हो जाती हैं।.

credits.actor: Farooq Sheikh,Abhimanyu Singh,Celina Jaitley,Manmeet Singh,Rukhsar Rehman,Shammi,Shobha Khote,Dadhi Raj

programme.title: रोड टू संगम
programme.sub-title: A devout Muslim Indian man is tasked with repairing a lorry in order to transport the ashes of Mahatma Gandhi. However, when communal violence strikes, he is left with a troubling dilemma
programme.desc: एक धर्मानिष्ठ मुस्लिम, हस्मत को कार की मरम्मत करने के लिए कहा जाता है, जिसमें महात्मा गांधी की अस्थियों को रखा गया है। हालांकि, स्थिति जल्द, जटिल होती है जब समुदाय में हिंसा से प्रचंड उत्पात होता है।.

credits.actor: Paresh Rawal,Om Puri,Pavan Malhotra,Javed Sheikh,Swati Chitnis,Vijay Mishra,Rajan Bhise

programme.desc: हिम्मतराम अपने शराबी बेटे, सुंदरलाल को अस्वीकार करता है और सब कुछ अपनी अविवाहित पोती, सुमन को दे देता है। सुंदरलाल अपना नाम पिता के वसीयत नामे में शामिल करने के लिए विभिन्न तरीकें अपनाता है।.

credits.actor: Saurabh Chakrawbarti,Banwarhlal Jhol,Aarti Kandpal,Sanjay Keni,Siraj Khan,Sudesh Lehri,Johny Lever,Sailesh Lodha

programme.title: रनबंका
programme.sub-title: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances
programme.desc: साधारण इंजीनियर राहुल अपनी पत्नी और बेटे के साथ मथुरा आता है। जहा एक गैंगस्टर उसकी पत्नी के प्रति आकर्षित होता है और उसे उससे शादी के लिए मजबूर करता है, तब उसे वह रोकने के लिए हर संभव कोशिश करता है।.

credits.actor: Maniesh Paul,Ravi Kishan,Pooja Thakur,Rudra Kaushik,Avya Agarwal,Avinash Dwivedi

programme.title: बम बम बोले
programme.sub-title: An idealist elder brother lands in a dilemma after he misplaces his little sister's shoes. Unable to afford a new pair, the siblings agree to share the shoes, leading to several escapades
programme.desc: भाई बहन, जूते की एक जोड़ी साझा करने का फैसला करते हैं जब तक कि उनके पिता नया जूता नहीं खरीदते हैं। लेकिन हालात बदलते हैं जब नौकरी खोजने में असमर्थ उनके पिता पर अपराधी होने का संदेह किया जाता है।.

programme.title: रोटी
programme.sub-title: Mangal Singh escapes prison and begins a new life, unknowingly befriending his victim's family. As he seeks redemption, his past catches up, compelling him to confront his previous misdeeds
programme.desc: मंगल सिंह जेल से भाग जाता है और एक नया जीवन शुरू करता है और अनजाने में अपने पीड़ित परिवार से दोस्ती कर लेता है। वह खुद को सुधारने की कोशिश करता है पर उसे अपने पिछले कुकर्मों का सामना करना पड़ता है।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna (Mangal Singh),Mumtaz (Bijli),Nirupa Roy (Malti),Sujit Kumar (Police Inspector),Jagdeep (Khadak Singh),Om Prakash (Lalaji)

programme.title: ख्वाहिश
programme.sub-title: Two individuals fall in love and marry against their parents' wishes. However, their life takes a dramatic turn when the woman is diagnosed with a life-threatening disease
programme.desc: कॉलेज के प्रेमी, अमर और लेखा शादी करने का फैसला करते हैं और अपने जीवन को अनुकूल करने के लिए सामंजस्य करते हैं। जब हालात व्यवस्थित होते है, लेखा को पता चलता है कि उसे ल्यूकेमिया है।.

credits.actor: Mallika Sherawat,Himanshu Malik,Shivaji Satam,Mahmud Babai,Shahbaaz Khan

programme.title: औलाद
programme.sub-title: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns
programme.desc: अपनी पत्नी को मरा हुआ मानकर आनंद अपना बच्चा यशोदा को दे देता है, जिसने अपने पति और अपने बच्चे को खो दिया है। हालांकि, वह दुविधा का सामना करता है, जब उसकी पत्नी वापस आ जाती है।.

credits.actor: Jeetendra (Anand),Jayapradha (Yashoda),Sridevi (Devki),Vinod Mehra (Vicky),Saeed Jaffrey (Anand's chacha),Asrani (Raja),Baby Guddu (Kishan),Manmohan Krishna (Vicky's Father),Dina Pathak (Savitri)

programme.title: जजन्तरम ममन्तरम
programme.sub-title: Aditya finds himself on an island after surviving a shipwreck. Here, he realises he is a giant amongst its inhabitants, who think he is going to save them from a terrifying demon
programme.desc: जहाज के टूट जाने के बाद आदित्य, एक द्वीप पर रास्ता भटक जाता है। वह पाता है कि वहाँ, वह अन्य निवासियों से विशालकाय है, जो उसे एक दानव के विरुद्ध अपना रक्षक मानते हैं।.

credits.actor: Jaaved Jaaffery,Gulshan Grover,Manev Kaul,Joy Fernandes,Nishith Dadhich,Dilip Joglekar,Kavita Murkar,Dipannita Sharma

programme.title: मासूम
programme.sub-title: D K Malhotra leads a peaceful life with his wife and two daughters. But all of this changes when he is forced to bring a boy, who is his son from a previous relationship, home after his mother dies
programme.desc: एक पारिवारिक व्यक्ति का जीवन बदलता है, जब उसे पता चलता है कि उसका एक नाजायज बेटा है। बच्चे की माँ मरणासन्न के दौरान, उसे उसके पिता के साथ रहने के लिए भेजती है।.

credits.actor: Naseeruddin Shah,Shabana Azmi,Supriya Pathak,Jugal Hansraj,Urmila,Saeed Jaffrey,Ram Gopal Bajaj,Satish Kaushik,Aziz Qureshi,Pran Talwar,Tanuja

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఆస్ట్రేలియా
programme.sub-title: Experts examine the hazards of the Australian shoreline and the risks of deeper waters, while survivors share close encounters with dangerous marine predators
programme.desc: ప్రాణాలతో బయటపడినవారు ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ అవుట్‌బ్యాక్ నుండి తాము ఎదుర్కొన్న భయంకరమైన తప్పించుకునే అనుభవాలను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: సర్చ్ ఫర్ ద కింగ్ కోబ్రా
programme.sub-title: Austin Stevens, a photographer and herpetologist, travels to the remote jungles of Southern India in pursuit of the world's largest venomous snake, the king cobra
programme.desc: ఆస్టిన్, ప్రపంచంలోనే అతిపెద్ద విషపూరిత సర్పం కింగ్ కోబ్రా కోసం వెతుకుతూ దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలోని మారుమూల అరణ్యాలకు వెళతాడు.

programme.title: బ్రదర్‌హుడ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves
programme.desc: కెన్యాలోని మసాయి మారా రిజర్వ్‌లో నివసిస్తున్న ఐదు యువ సింహాల జీవితం, వేట, నివాస విషయంలో ఎదుర్కొంటున్న సమస్యలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: Super snakes
programme.desc: Snakes are a feature of nearly every culture in the world. 100,000 people die every year because of them. But we also owe our survival to snake predation on rodents. They attract a mythology which sometimes leaves the truth eating dust.

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్

programme.title: రేస్ అఫ్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals adapt through a series of small, random mutations and usually do so in order to compete more effectively for food, water and space. Crocodiles are certainly of an ancient lineage, they are believed to be 200 million years old. Sharks have gone through the process of adaptation and evolutionary experimentation as well
programme.desc: స్వీయ ర‌క్ష‌ణ‌లో భాగంగా పరిసరాలకు అనుగుణంగా అభివృద్ధి చెందిన జంతువుల గురించి వ్యాఖ్యాత వివ‌రిస్తారు.

programme.sub-title: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba are teaching their cubs survival skills whilst keeping them out of the jaws of big male cats
programme.desc: మూడు పెద్ద పిల్లి కుటుంబాలు ఉమ్మడి స్థలంలో సహజీవనం చేస్తూనే ప్రత్యర్థులను అధిగమించడానికి వారి నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: ఫియర్ ఆన్ ది సవన్నా
programme.sub-title: Authorities introduced lions in a rehabilitated national park where only herbivores lived, and fear overtook the park
programme.desc: కేవలం శాకాహారులు మాత్రమే నివసించే పునరుద్ధరించబడిన జాతీయ ఉద్యానవనంలో అధికారులు సింహాలను ప్రవేశపెట్టడంతో, ఆ పార్కులో భయం ఆవరిస్తుంది.

programme.title: ఎ గేమ్ ఆఫ్ లెపర్డ్ థ్రోన్స్
programme.sub-title: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని సాబి సాండ్స్‌లో ఉన్న చిరుతపులి రాజ కుటుంబ సభ్యుల మధ్య వివాదం గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ది డోర్స్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker provides comprehensive insights into the alluring biodiversity of the Himalayas, while focusing on the vivid wildlife
programme.desc: ఒక దర్శకుడు వివిధ రకాల వన్యప్రాణుల గురించి అన్వేషిస్తూ, హిమాలయాలలోని ఆకర్షణీయమైన జీవ వైవిధ్యం గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.sub-title: While the lion cubs at the Masai Mara Reserve prey on buffalo, one of them emerges to assert themselves as the dominant leader to guide the pride in attacking their victim
programme.desc: కెన్యాలోని మసాయి మారా రిజర్వ్‌లో నివసిస్తున్న ఐదు యువ సింహాల జీవితం, వేట, నివాస విషయంలో ఎదుర్కొంటున్న సమస్యలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: అటెన్‌బరోస్ లైఫ్ ఇన్ కలర్
programme.sub-title: In India, peacocks dazzle females with magnificent tail feathers; a tiny hummingbird in the deserts of North America unfurls his spectacular headdress as he dances for a mate; and in the darkness of a rainforest, powerful mandrill baboons signal their status with red and blue face masks, while tiny frogs warn of deadly poisons with brilliant colours
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the vital role that colour plays in the daily life of various species. For us humans, it is a source of aesthetic beauty and expression, but for animals it is an essential tool used for survival and without it, there would be catastrophic consequences. Colours help animals to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies. Attenborough explores nature's use of colour using technological advancements in camera equipment to reveal the world, as seen by animals.

programme.title: టైగర్ ఫిష్: ఆఫ్రికా పిరాన్హా
programme.sub-title: Tigerfish are terrifying freshwater predators. Extreme angler Andy Coetzee undertakes a hazardous journey to study the giant-sized species in their habitat in the Congo
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ఆఫ్రికా నదుల గుండా ప్రయాణిస్తూ, పదునైన దంతాలు కలిగిన చేప జాతి అయిన టైగర్ ఫిష్ ప్రవర్తనను అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ ఇళ్లలో చొరబడిన ప్రాణాంతకమైన పాములను పట్టుకునే క్రమంలో నిపుణులు ప్రమాదకర పరిస్థితులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: క్రికీ! ఇట్స్ ద ఇర్విన్స్
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియా జంతుశాలలో పనిచేస్తున్న ఇర్విన్ కుటుంబ సభ్యులు జంతువులను జాగ్రత్తగా చూసుకోవడానికి అనేక ఇబ్బందులు పడతారు.

programme.title: జ్యూయెల్స్ ఆఫ్ ద న్యాచురల్ వరల్డ్

programme.title: క్రికీ! ఇట్స్ ద ఇర్విన్స్
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియా జంతుశాలలో పనిచేస్తున్న ఇర్విన్ కుటుంబ సభ్యులు జంతువులను జాగ్రత్తగా చూసుకోవడానికి అనేక ఇబ్బందులు పడతారు.

programme.sub-title: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals

Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియా జంతుశాలలో పనిచేస్తున్న ఇర్విన్ కుటుంబ సభ్యులు జంతువులను జాగ్రత్తగా చూసుకోవడానికి అనేక ఇబ్బందులు పడతారు.

programme.title: జ్యూయెల్స్ ఆఫ్ ద న్యాచురల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Explores stunning natural landscapes and how animals act on their protective and fierce nature to survive and reproduce
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత జంతువుల భీకర స్వభావం, సంరక్షణ గురించి వివరిస్తూ, ప్రపంచంలోని పలు ప్రాంతాల వన్యప్రాణుల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: ఇంటు ది వైల్డ్: ఇండియా
programme.sub-title: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు భారతదేశ అపరిమితమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల గురించి అంతర్దృష్టిని అందించారు.

programme.title: జస్ట్ యానిమల్స్
programme.sub-title: Explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species
programme.desc: చిత్ర దర్శకుడు అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, భౌతిక లక్షణాలు, ప్రవర్తనలు, ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను విశ్లేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఆస్ట్రేలియా
programme.sub-title: Experts examine the hazards of the Australian shoreline and the risks of deeper waters. Later, survivors share close encounters with dangerous marine predators
programme.desc: ప్రాణాలతో బయటపడినవారు ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ అవుట్‌బ్యాక్ నుండి తాము ఎదుర్కొన్న భయంకరమైన తప్పించుకునే అనుభవాలను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: సర్చ్ ఫర్ ద కింగ్ కోబ్రా
programme.sub-title: Austin Stevens, a photographer and herpetologist, travels to the remote jungles of Southern India in pursuit of the world's largest venomous snake, the king cobra
programme.desc: ఆస్టిన్, ప్రపంచంలోనే అతిపెద్ద విషపూరిత సర్పం కింగ్ కోబ్రా కోసం వెతుకుతూ దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలోని మారుమూల అరణ్యాలకు వెళతాడు.

programme.title: బ్రదర్‌హుడ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the activities of female and male lions with their new cubs who form a group of thirteen to hunt their prey
programme.desc: కెన్యాలోని మసాయి మారా రిజర్వ్‌లో నివసిస్తున్న ఐదు యువ సింహాల జీవితం, వేట, నివాస విషయంలో ఎదుర్కొంటున్న సమస్యలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: Super snakes
programme.desc: Snakes are a feature of nearly every culture in the world. 100,000 people die every year because of them. But we also owe our survival to snake predation on rodents. They attract a mythology which sometimes leaves the truth eating dust.

programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: రేస్ అఫ్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: Numerous animals adapt through a series of small mutations in order to compete more effectively in the game of evolution
programme.desc: స్వీయ ర‌క్ష‌ణ‌లో భాగంగా పరిసరాలకు అనుగుణంగా అభివృద్ధి చెందిన జంతువుల గురించి వ్యాఖ్యాత వివ‌రిస్తారు.

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్

programme.title: డాగ్స్ ఇన్ ద ల్యాండ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker follows the extraordinary journey of closely-bonded wild dogs in Zimbabwe, capturing their tender moments to wild hunting

programme.title: ఫియర్ ఆన్ ది సవన్నా
programme.sub-title: Authorities introduced lions in a rehabilitated national park where only herbivores lived; fear overtook the park

programme.sub-title: Aussies who've survived deadly threats in their own backyard share their stories as the country's suburban residents increasingly find themselves in the vicinity of dangerous wildlife

programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: రివర్ మాన్స్టర్స్
programme.sub-title: The host, a biologist who is an extreme angler, explores freshwater mysteries and local folklore, to debunk fascinating myths and track down harrowing tales
programme.desc: జీవశాస్త్రవేత్త జెరెమీ వేడ్ పురాణాలు, స్వచ్ఛమైననీటి రహస్యాలు, జానపద కథలను అన్వేషించడానికి బయలుదేరాడు.

credits.actor: Jeremy Wade,Vic Hislop,David Buckmeier,Mark Spitzer,Tim Mousseau,Daniel Göz

programme.sub-title: Childhood friends Sanjay and Anjali do not realise their feelings for each other until Anjali gets engaged to Rohit. Sanjay arrives to help with the preparations, but has another plan up his sleeve

programme.sub-title: Pia travels to Delhi to meet a prospective groom whom she is determined to turn down. However, fate plays a tricky game on her when she meets her soulmate in the very city that she dreads visiting

programme.title: दीवाना मस्ताना

programme.sub-title: Destiny entangles Sapna with a bereaved Vicky and his fun-loving younger brother Prem Oberoi in a tapestry of romance, heartbreak, and sacrifice
programme.desc: एक व्यापारी, विकी, अपने छोटे भाई प्रेम से प्यार करता है, जो लड़कियों को लुभाने की कोशिश करता रहता है। परिवार को लगता है कि सचिव, सपना विकी के लिए एक अच्छी पत्नी होगी पर वो प्रेम से प्यार करती है।.

SpongeBob SquarePants: Something Smells / Bossy Boots
programme.sub-title: Mundgeruch / Die Kuschel-Krabbe
programme.desc: SpongeBob macht sich aus den Resten in Kühl- und Speiseschrank ein Sonntagsfrühstück, das übelsten Mundgeruch hervorruft. Das merken alle außer ihm, und er wundert sich, warum alle Leute in Panik vor ihm davonrennen. Patrick vermutet, es liege daran, dass Sponge so hässlich sei. Das stürzt unseren Schwamm zwar in schwerste Depressionen, ändert aber nichts am Sachverhalt. Erst als auch Patrick von der Stinkmampfe kostet, merken die beiden, was eigentlich los ist... Mr. Krabs kündigt an, dass seine Tochter Perla während ihrer Sommerferien in der Krossen Krabbe arbeiten werde und auch eine Menge neuer Ideen habe. In der Tat, denn Perla verwandelt die Burger-Bude ruck-zuck und unter Einsatz erheblicher finanzieller Mittel in ein Jugendlokal, dass den schönen Namen "Kuschelkrabbe" trägt. Nun gibt es Salat statt Burger und die Angestellten werden gezwungen, ausnehmend alberne Uniformen zu tragen. Thaddäus macht das alles nicht lange mit, und sogar der langmütige SpongeBob hält es irgendwann nicht mehr aus. Er geht zu Mr. Krabs, dem im Verlauf des Gesprächs schnell klar wird, dass er Geld zum Fenster hinauswirft. Doch er traut sich nicht, seine Tochter zu feuern. Nun soll SpongeBob das übernehmen - und macht dabei eine überraschende Feststellung..

programme.desc: Stein trifft endlich sein Model-Vorbild Franz Roll, der Stein auf eine Mission schickt: Er soll ein legendäres Model-Artefakt finden - die verlorene Regenbogen-Hotpants von Pharao Atraxes mit dem Apfelhintern - um zu beweisen, dass er würdig ist, mit ihm zu arbeiten. Während das Trio um die Welt reist, um dieses sagenumwobene Kleidungsstück zu finden, wetteifern Papier und Schere darum, wer der unterstützendste Freund ist - in der Hoffnung, später, wenn Stein berühmt ist, der Leiter seiner Entourage zu sein und der faulste Schmarotzer überhaupt zu werden. Stein muss seine Model-Fähigkeiten unter Beweis stellen und dieses lange verlorene Rätsel lösen, sonst riskiert er, seinen Lebenstraum zu verlieren.

Deren Kapitän schickt die beiden los, ein Ersatzteil für den Bootsmotor zu besorgen, nicht ohne ihre Seelen als Pfand zu behalten. Schlimm genug, doch als die Verzweifelten Mr. Krabs ihr Leid klagen, nimmt das Unheil erst richtig seinen Lauf. Denn der Geisterkapitän hat SpongeBob eine Dublone für das Ersatzteil mitgegeben, und die weckt nun Mr. Krabs' Geldgier..

programme.desc: Schere, Stein und Papier sind schockiert zu entdecken, dass die Ratten Bros in ihrer Freizeit Kinder unterrichten, was ihr Weltbild erschüttert, dass sie selbst die besseren Menschen seien. Die beiden Gruppen treten in einem ,Altruistik-Duell"' gegeneinander an - einem Wettbewerb darin, wer mehr Gutes für die Gesellschaft tun kann. Während die Ratten Bros feiern, dass sie Schere, Stein und Papier eifersüchtig gemacht haben, beginnt Brody zu hinterfragen, ob er wirklich aus Gutwillen handelt oder nur, um sie zu ärgern. // Schere geht mit Lolly, dem Popstar, aus - von der Stein und Papier große Fans sind. Nach einem katastrophalen Date veröffentlicht Lolly ein vernichtendes Album über Schere, wodurch er zum meistgehassten Menschen der Welt wird; sogar seine besten Freunde wenden sich gegen ihn. Schere muss seinen Ruf in der öffentlichen Meinung wiederherstellen.
